periodicity: N=30 p=10 q=23   (v_{n+p} = v_n + q for all n >= N)
p*gamma - q*n for n = N .. N+p-1: 20 17 24 21 18 25 22 19 26 23
so gamma(n) = ceil((23 n + 17) / 10) for all n >= N; exceptions below N: 2(-1) 3(-1) 5(-1) 6(-1) 8(-1) 9(-1) 12(-1) 15(-1) 18(-1)
